items.title: Declare consent to rent increase
items.quote: Ihre Antwort benötigen wir bis Ende Januar 2027.
items.computation: Letter was hand-delivered by the cooperative's own messenger into the mailbox on 18.11.2026 at 8:50, so receipt (Empfang) is confirmed as 18.11.2026 (no postal-delivery fiction needed). Under § 558b Abs. 1 BGB the tenant must declare consent to a rent increase 'bis zum Ablauf des zweiten Kalendermonats nach Empfang des Erhöhungsverlangens'. Counting calendar months after the month of receipt (November 2026): 1st following calendar month = December 2026, 2nd = January 2027. So the statutory period ends with the expiry of 31.01.2027. That date, 31 January 2027, falls on a Sunday. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a declaration falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. The next day, 01.02.2027, is a Monday and not a public holiday in Saarland, so it becomes the final day for the tenant's consent to reach the cooperative.

items.title: New rent (434,50 €) takes effect
items.quote:
Wir bitten Sie um Ihre Zustimmung, das Nutzungsentgelt ab dem 01.02.2027 um 10 % auf
434,50 € zu erhöhen.
items.computation: The letter states the increase is to take effect from 01.02.2027. This matches § 558b Abs. 1 BGB, under which (if consent is given in time) the increased rent is owed from the start of the third calendar month after receipt of the increase request: receipt in November 2026 → 1st following month December 2026, 2nd January 2027, 3rd February 2027 → effective date 01.02.2027. No weekend/holiday adjustment applies to an effective date (as opposed to a deadline for an act), so it stays 01.02.2027.
